tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its readable content as JSON: plain text or Markdown (headings, lists, links kept), plus title, description, author, publish date, site name, language and preview image. Ads, menus and scripts are stripped. Also reads PDF, Word, Excel and CSV links. Failed fetches

tools.name: read_pages
tools.description: Read up to 5 public web pages or documents (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV) in one call, in parallel. Returns each one's readable text or Markdown plus metadata, and lists any that failed. Charged only if at least one URL was read. Price: $0.006 USDC (x402).

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Get a web page's metadata without its text: title, description, preview image, favicon, language, canonical URL, author and dates, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, RSS/Atom feed links, and its schema.org structured data (JSON-LD: products with prices and ratings, articles, recipes, events, organiza

tools.name: page_links
tools.description: List every link on a web page with its anchor text, marked internal (same site) or external, deduplicated. Use scope=internal to crawl a site, or external to find outbound references. Price: $0.001 USDC (x402).

tools.name: page_tables
tools.description: Extract every HTML table on a web page as JSON: caption, header row and data rows as arrays of cell text. Good for prices, stats, schedules, rankings and spec sheets. Price: $0.002 USDC (x402).

tools.name: read_feed
tools.description: Get the latest posts from a blog or news site as JSON (title, link, date, author, summary). Give it a feed URL, or just the site's page and it finds the RSS/Atom feed automatically. Price: $0.001 USDC (x402).

tools.name: site_sitemap
tools.description: List a website's page URLs (with last-modified dates) from its sitemap. Give it any page on the site: it checks robots.txt and /sitemap.xml, follows sitemap indexes, and reads .xml.gz sitemaps. Price: $0.002 USDC (x402).

tools.name: read_rendered_page
tools.description: Like /v1/read, but loads the page in a real browser first, so content built by JavaScript (online shops, web apps, single-page sites) is included. Use it when /v1/read comes back empty or incomplete. Returns the readable text or Markdown plus metadata. Price: $0.005 USDC (x402).

tools.name: page_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a web page in a real browser and get the image back (JPEG by default, or PNG). Choose the window size, or full_page=true for the whole page (up to 8,000 pixels tall). Price: $0.005 USDC (x402).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_page, read_pages, page_metadata, page_links, read_feed, site_sitemap, page_screenshot · Private data: read_pages · Public sink: read_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_page, read_pages, page_metadata, page_links, read_feed, site_sitemap, page_screenshot · Private data: read_pages · Public sink: read_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
